subject: Launch MAP & evaluation cadence — technical owners & timelines
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@glyphhealth.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@glyphhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Launch MAP & evaluation cadence — technical owners & timelines

Hi Lena / Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the evaluation sprint and close timeline so everyone is aligned on owners and next steps. High level:

- Goal: run a 3-week eval to validate retrieval + instruction-following for clinical-summarization use cases and confirm cost/latency envelope for production.
- Key success criteria: 1) end-to-end latency < 700ms P95 for 1kQPS batched simulation; 2) summary ROUGE improvements vs baseline >= 8 pts on our seed set; 3) no PII leakage on sampled outputs.
- Proposed timeline: kickoff this week (Jun 30), data ingestion & baseline tests (Week 1), model tuning & integration tests (Week 2), stakeholder demo + decision checkpoint (Week 3, target Jul 21).

Technical owners (we're introducing them here):
- Diego Fernandez (Solutions Engineer) — technical integration, ephemeral keys, observability hooks.
- Neha Kapoor (ML Engineer) — eval design, prompt sets, metric collection.

Marcus is copied for account-level milestones and contract questions. I attached a first-draft MAP and a short data-access checklist to speed the onboarding (see attachments).

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm who will own procurement/PO on the Glyph side (name + email)?
2) Please confirm an initial 60–90 minute kickoff window this week — options below.
3) Any regulatory constraints we should include now (data residency, specific redaction rules)?

Kickoff availability (PST):
- Tue Jun 30 2:00–3:30pm
- Wed Jul 1 10:00–11:30am
- Thu Jul 2 9:00–10:30am

If none work, propose two windows and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the eval running.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft-20260630.pdf (pdf), data-access-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Lena Park <lena@glyphhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@glyphhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch MAP & evaluation cadence — technical owners & timelines

Thanks Grace — this looks great and aligns with our internal urgency. Quick answers:

- Procurement: Nadia Chen (nadia.chen@glyphhealth.com) will own the PO and contracts.
- Regulatory: we are covered under our BAA but we do need explicit redaction guidance for patient identifiers before any dataset leaves our environment. I'll attach our standard redaction checklist after kickoff.

We can do Wed Jul 1 10:00–11:30am PST for kickoff.

Two small asks ahead of the meeting:
1) Can the team share a short checklist of what SDK/integration endpoints you need for a staging-only ingest?
2) Where can we review Redwood's SOC 2 and data retention policies?

Looking forward to introductions at the call.

Best,
Lena Park
Director of Engineering — Data Platforms
GlyphHealth

--
Lena Park
GlyphHealth
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@glyphhealth.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@glyphhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Nadia Chen <nadia.chen@glyphhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch MAP & evaluation cadence — technical owners & timelines

Perfect — Wed Jul 1 10:00am PST booked. Calendar invite coming from me in a minute.

Quick intros in advance so your teams have context:
- Diego Fernandez (diego_fernandez@redwood.com) — our Solutions Engineer leading the integration. Diego will walk through the staging ingest flow, auth patterns (short-lived API keys), and observability hooks.
- Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.com) — ML Engineer focused on evaluation: prompt sets, metric harness, and runbooks for A/B comparison and regression alerts.

Lena — answers to your pre-asks:
1) Integration checklist (high level) — SDK language support (Python/JavaScript), staging endpoint URL, sample ingestion schema (CSV/JSON), and ephemeral API keys. I attached the data-access-checklist.xlsx that enumerates required fields.
2) SOC 2 & retention — here's a link to our security packet: https://drive.redwood.com/security/GH-share (I've added a redaction-guidelines.pdf to the attachments as a starter). Marcus will follow up on any additional compliance docs.

Diego & Neha: please review the attached MAP draft and come prepared with any questions about required logs / sample payloads. Diego — can you pull the expected ingestion payload shape into the Drive folder ahead of the call?

Thanks all — see you Wed.

Best,
Grace

Attachments: redaction-guidelines.pdf (pdf)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@glyphhealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch MAP & evaluation cadence — technical owners & timelines

Thanks Grace — quick technical note ahead of the kickoff:

Short checklist I'll bring to the call and upload to the shared Drive:
- Staging ingest: sample payloads (one full record + one redacted example) in JSON; expected batch sizes; typical document lengths (tokens).
- Auth: we'll use short-lived API keys for staging; if you prefer VPC peering for data-in-place tests we can scope that in Week 2.
- Observability: please confirm an internal Slack channel or PagerDuty contact for test-time alerts; we will wire a lightweight tracing hook (trace id in response) so you can correlate logs.
- Resource sizing: do you expect to run parallel simulation jobs (yes/no)? If yes, what's the max parallelism?

Neha: I'll coordinate to get the eval harness prepopulated with your seed prompts.

Lena: could you share the redaction checklist you mentioned — even a one-page PDF will help us confirm the transform steps we run in staging.

Cheers,
Diego
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@glyphhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Launch MAP & evaluation cadence — technical owners & timelines

Thanks team — call went well yesterday. A couple quick items from our side to keep momentum:

1) Procurement: Nadia will send a PO template early next week; how should we reference the trial usage in the contract? We want to avoid billing surprises.
2) Data sample: attached a small redacted sample (redaction performed per our checklist). Please confirm it looks good for staging ingest.
3) Timeline: Jul 21 decision checkpoint looks fine — we may push to Jul 23 if we need extra time for internal sign-off, will update you by Jul 14.

Diego — please confirm you uploaded the ingestion schema + example to the Drive folder. Neha — happy to coordinate on seed prompts; I'll loop in a product manager if we need prioritization.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samir Rao
Senior Engineering Manager
GlyphHealth
